scripts.verify: npm test && npm run build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy: npm run verify && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply INQUIRY_DB --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply INQUIRY_DB --remote
